purpose: Bind the result-independent validation, decision mapping, manuscript topology, and paper-only rendering for the prospective corrected DenseOn state-by-operator factorial before any factorial output exists.

visibility_at_freeze.note: The paper positions and every sign/interval branch were fixed before the Muon source checkpoint and before any factorial outcome.

input_contract.summary_manifest: Require status complete and exact scientific/implementation identities.
input_contract.inference: Recheck every point estimate and interval as finite, every interval as ordered, and every positive/negative/inconclusive decision from the frozen zero-exclusion rule.
input_contract.source_addressing: Verify the byte count and SHA-256 of every consumed summary table before rendering.

rendering_contract.abstract: Report all three crossed effects and the predeclared interpretation rather than leaving the mechanism conclusion at the historical spectral negative; the complete expanded abstract must remain within the official 200-word ACL limit.
rendering_contract.main_mechanism: After mapping optimizer-induced weight trajectories and rejecting operator fingerprints as sufficient explanations, state the carried weight-state effect, averaged continuation-operator effect, and interaction with exact 95% intervals and decisions.
rendering_contract.main_conclusion: Propagate the same source-bound crossed result into the main Conclusion.
rendering_contract.appendix: Show all three co-primary estimates and decisions in one compact table and point to the exact 126 seed-task contrasts and five-stage probe tables.

result_blind_branching.positive_interaction: Support the closed-loop state-operator feedback account, while separately naming any supported state or operator main effects.
result_blind_branching.weight_state_only: Attribute the practical gain primarily to the reached weight state, not a universally better local direction.
result_blind_branching.operator_only: Attribute the supported branch-horizon contribution to the continuation transform.
result_blind_branching.weight_and_operator_without_interaction: Report additive carried-state and operator benefits without claiming state-specific complementarity.
result_blind_branching.no_positive_effect: Retain the retrieval result without a positive mechanism claim and disclose any supported negative estimand.

complete_paper_layout_amendment.reason: The complete synthetic-results paper revealed an over-wide single-column factorial appendix table. Use a double-column table with the same three estimates, intervals, decisions and label. No numerical or inferential change.

paper_scope: The ACL manuscript is the sole publication deliverable. Summary CSVs and manifests are audit evidence rather than independent publication artifacts.
claim_boundary: The crossed branch can distinguish a carried state effect, an averaged continuation effect, and their interaction for one source-checkpoint pair and one 50K branch horizon. It cannot identify universal mediation of the full 500K trajectory.
